info.title: payment-api
info.description: The payment HTTP routes and OpenAPI contract over the chain-neutral wallet and index abstractions. An asset is its network's own asset id (`native`, or a token); no chain or asset is named in this contract.

get.summary: Read readiness and network health from memory
get.description: Public memory-only readiness: ready when at least one network is configured and no network's last indexing step failed. No RPC or storage reads.
The contract every route is generated from; public, like the health routes.

500.description: The contract could not be encoded

get.description: Every asset of every configured network, with its metadata. This is the only list of assets the wallet routes accept.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Only jobs of this chain; with `network`.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Only jobs of this network of `chain`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, 1 to 1000; 100 by default.

400.description: Malformed query or limit, or a chain without its network

get.description: The job's outcome, what it was given and what its worker has done; for a broadcast, how many transactions it signed and the nodes accepted.

get.summary: List every configured network, its indexing and its RPC nodes
get.description: Every network the configuration names, what its indexer did since the process started, and its nodes, each URL parsed.

503.description: The nodes could not be read

post.summary: Add RPC nodes to one or more networks
post.description: Appends each node after its network's current ones, stores every changed list in one write (all or none), then sends every later call of those networks to their new lists. A provider's nodes for several networks are added at once this way.

400.description: Malformed node, or a list above 16 nodes

503.description: The nodes could not be stored

get.summary: List a network's last kept blocks

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, 1 to 100; 20 by default.

400.description: Malformed query or limit

get.summary: Read one kept block of a network, with its kept transactions

404.description: The network is not configured, or no live block is kept at this position

put.description: Stores the nodes, then sends every later call of the network (indexing, wallets, broadcast) to them, failing over in order; calls already sent finish on the node they reached. The nodes are not verified here: the chain verifies them on the next start, which uses the stored list whatever the configuration file says.

400.description: Malformed node list

503.description: The nodes could not be stored

delete.summary: Remove one RPC node of a network
delete.description: Removes the node at `index`, stores the rest and uses them from now on. A network's last node cannot be removed.

400.description: It is the network's last node

404.description: No such node, or network not configured

503.description: The nodes could not be stored

get.summary: Read a network's newest block, or its last block at or before a time
get.description: Read from the node. With `at`, a binary search over block times: about log2(tip) block reads, and on Bitcoin, whose block times only roughly ascend, possibly a few blocks off.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description:
RFC 3339 time (`2026-10-01T00:00:00Z`) or Unix seconds: answer the
last block at or before it. Absent: the newest block.

400.description: Malformed `at`

404.description: The network is not configured, or `at` is before its first block

422.description: The network cannot find blocks by time

get.summary: Find a network's last block at or before a time, streaming the search
get.description: `text/event-stream`, read from the node: `event: probe` with `{"low":{"position","timestamp"},"high":{…}}` after each step of the binary search (the range narrows: the block is at or after `low`, before `high`); then `event: found` with `{"position","timestamp"}`, or `event: error` with `{"message"}` (cannot find blocks by time, before the first block, the node failed). The stream then ends.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description:
RFC 3339 time (`2026-10-01T00:00:00Z`) or Unix seconds: find the last
block at or before it.

400.description: Malformed `at`

get.summary: List a network's pending or mined transactions

parameters.name: pending
parameters.description:
Pending ones (true, the default), oldest sent first; or mined ones in
live blocks (false), latest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, 1 to 500; 100 by default.

400.description: Malformed query or limit

get.summary: Read what the store holds and its last day
get.description: Counts across every network, and per hour over the last day: blocks and transactions by chain time (up to the newest kept block), jobs and trigger runs by this server's time.

post.description: Stores every trigger or none, all on one configured network, each with an `id` chosen here that never changes: a template of several triggers (gas funding and sweep) never lands half.

400.description: Malformed body or id, several networks, or a send from This to This

404.description: Network or sent asset is not configured

422.description: An id is taken or repeated

put.description: Replaces everything but its id and creation time; a body `id` is refused. Setting `enabled` to false pauses it.

400.description: Malformed body, or a send from This to This

404.description: No such trigger, or network not configured

delete.summary: Delete a trigger and its runs

get.description: Keyed wallets and watched addresses, a page in wallet ID order, each with its tags and its indexes: their balances (exact atomic units), progress and legs.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
`next_cursor` of the previous page (the last wallet id); absent for
the first page.

400.description: Malformed query or limit

post.summary: Import a wallet's key, watch an address, or generate a wallet, in one configured network
post.description: With `secret`, imports a raw private key and keeps it; with `address` too, the key must derive that address. With `address` alone, watches it without its key. With neither, generates a key and keeps it; retrying makes another wallet. The wallet is created without indexes (`POST /v1/wallets/{id}/index`). An address already kept answers its wallet as is (200), except that importing the key of a watch-only wallet keeps the key; its tags and indexes stay.

200.description: The address was already kept: its wallet

400.description: Malformed body, address or key, or a key that derives another address

503.description: Generation or the store is unavailable

get.description: The wallet's network, canonical address, whether it is keyed, the assets it is indexed in and how far each is; never its key.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: `{chain}.{network}.{address}`, as a create call returned it.

400.description: Malformed wallet ID

post.summary: Index a wallet in an asset
post.description: Indexes the wallet in `asset` from `start` (absent: the chain's tip), at once (the network's next indexing step picks it). An asset already indexed keeps its first start (200). A `start` older than the network's `max_history_days` is refused; one the node no longer serves moves forward to the first block it serves before indexing begins.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: `{chain}.{network}.{address}`, as a create call returned it.

200.description: The asset was already indexed: its index

400.description: Malformed body or wallet ID, or a start older than the network's history limit

404.description: Wallet is unknown, or the asset is not configured

503.description: The node or the store is unavailable

delete.summary: Stop indexing a wallet in an asset
delete.description: Forgets the index and its progress: its balance and history are no longer read. Creating it again starts from its new start.

400.description: Malformed wallet ID

patch.summary: Pause or resume a wallet's index
patch.description: `paused`: skipped, no facts kept for blocks while paused; what is kept stays. `indexing`: from `paused` or `no_data` (clearing its reason), it continues from its last indexed block, backfilling what it missed.

400.description: Malformed body or wallet ID, or `no_data` asked for

get.description: The index's legs in live blocks, latest first, each with the balance right after it. Its pending legs are on the index itself.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
`next_cursor` of the previous page (a `seq`); absent for the first
page.

400.description: Malformed wallet ID, query or limit

put.description: Tags the wallet, keyed or watch-only; tagging twice keeps one tag.

400.description: Malformed wallet ID or tag

404.description: Wallet is unknown, or network not configured

delete.description: Removes the tag from the wallet.

400.description: Malformed wallet ID or tag

404.description: No such wallet or tag, or network not configured

get.summary: Read one page of a wallet's history
get.description: The wallet's transactions in `asset`, in chain order, with only its own legs of that asset; a fee is shown where this address paid it in the native asset. Block rewards count in the balance but are not transactions.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: An asset id of the wallet's network; default `native`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page; absent for the first page.

400.description: Malformed wallet ID, query, cursor, or limit

404.description: Network or asset is not configured

post.summary: Enqueue an ordered send from a wallet
post.description: Enqueues one send job of `asset` from the keyed wallet: its transfers are signed up front and broadcast in order. A 202 response means queued, not submitted: `GET /v1/jobs/{id}` reports the outcome. Indexing records the transactions once they are mined, for the assets the wallet is watched in. A watch-only wallet answers 422.

400.description: Malformed body, wallet ID, amount, or destination

404.description: Network or asset is not configured

503.description: The queue or store is unavailable

Asset.description: Metadata of the asset an amount is denominated in.

decimals.description: Decimal places between atomic and display units.

display_decimals.description: Fractional digits a view shows; always present, null: all.

id.description: Asset ID within the chain (`native` or a token identifier).

name.description: Display name, when known; always present.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, when known; always present.

assets.description: Assets in network, then id, order.

Block.description:
A kept block: its `block` row, its kept transactions in block order and
its kept rewards. The API shows it as is. Read whole in one query: its
children come as JSON arrays SQLite builds (`transactions`, `rewards`).

archived_at.description: Unix ms a reorg archived it; null while live.

parent.description: Its parent's id, once that is kept.

parent_position.description: Its parent's position; null for genesis.

transactions.description: Its kept transactions, in block order.

blocks.description: The last kept blocks, latest first.

ChainHour.description: One hour of chain time, across every network.

transactions.description: Kept transactions mined in those blocks.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds, when reported; always present.

ConfiguredNetwork.description: One configured network, its indexing, and its nodes.

oneOf.description: Its block explorer links; always present, null when none is configured.

indexing.description: What its indexer did since the process started.

max_history_days.description:
How old, in days, a wallet's start may be; null: no limit. Always
present.

CreateWallet.description:
`POST /v1/wallets` body: a wallet in one network, created without
indexes. With `secret`, its key is imported and kept; else with
`address`, the address is watched without a key; with neither, a new key
is generated and kept.

address.description:
Address text in any form the chain accepts; with `secret`, the
address the key must derive.

secret.description:
A raw private key in the chain's import format: Ethereum hex, Solana
Base58 secret or keypair, Bitcoin WIF.

asset.description: The asset id to index the wallet in.

start.description:
The native position to index from, no older than the network's
`max_history_days`. Absent: from the chain's tip, as a generated
wallet (it has no past) must be.

DetailedEndpoint.description: A node with its own bounds.

bounds.description:
Per-call limits: `timeout_ms`, `max_request_bytes`,
`max_response_bytes`; each defaults when absent.

url.description: `http` or `https` URL naming a host, without a fragment.

ErrorBody.description:
The body of every error response: `message` is always present, the
failing transfer's index only when one transfer of a send failed.

failed_index.description:
Zero-based index of the transfer that failed. Present only when one
transfer of a send failed.

address.description: An address's page; `{address}` is replaced by the address.

transaction.description: A transaction's page; `{tx}` is replaced by the transaction id.

Indexing.description: One network's indexing health, from memory.

error.description: The last failure, cleared by the next kept block; always present.

last.description: Native position of the last block kept; always present.

reorgs.description: Kept blocks archived because the chain took them back.

tip.description: The chain's produced tip at the last step; always present.

accepted.description: How many of them, in broadcast order, the nodes accepted.

attempts.description: Executions started since it was last fresh.

deadline.description: Not started after this, Unix ms; always present.

progress.description: What its worker has done so far; always present.

reason.description:
Why it failed, or why its last attempt is being retried; always
present.

run_at.description: Not started before this, Unix ms: the next run of a pending job.

signed.description: A broadcast's transactions signed (0 for other kinds).

topic.description: What it locks: jobs whose topics conflict run one at a time, in id order.

jobs.description: The jobs last written, latest first.

Leg.description:
One `leg` row: a transaction's leg, or a block's reward; the API shows
it as is.

kind.description: 0 received, 1 spent, 2 burned, 3 minted, 4 fee, 5 reward.

seq.description:
Its index's leg sequence: 1 + the highest the index has kept,
unique per index; `None` while pending.

total.description: Its index's balance right after it; `None` while pending.

transaction.description: Its transaction; null for a reward.

wallet_index_id.description: The wallet index it is kept for: its address's index in its asset.

legs.description:
Live mined legs, latest first, each with the balance after it
(`total`).

next_cursor.description:
Pass as `before` for the next page; null on the last page. Always
present.

Listing.description: One configured asset: its id, where its wallets live, and what they hold.

asset.description:
The id every wallet route's `asset` takes within `network`: `native`,
or a token's chain-owned id.

network.description: The chain and network this asset's wallets live on.

Network.description:
The chain and network a wallet, address, or transaction belongs to. It
always ships as one nested object, never as two sibling fields.

indexing.description: What its indexer did since the process started.

NetworkList.description: Every configured network, or the ones a change touched.

networks.description: Networks in chain, then name, order.

NetworkNode.description: One node to add, and its network.

Report.description: The memory-only health snapshot of this process.

ready.description: At least one network, and none whose last step failed.

nodes.description: Nodes to append, each after its network's current ones, in order.

oneOf.description: The node's URL, with default bounds.

RpcEndpoint.description:
One RPC node, written as the configuration file's `endpoints` writes it.
The URL carries everything: userinfo (HTTP Basic), query keys, a key in
the path, or `header.<Name>=value` parameters sent as headers.

RpcNode.description: One RPC node: its URL, parsed.

index.description: Its position in failover order; what removing it takes.

port.description: The port, the scheme's default when unwritten; always present.

timeout_ms.description: Longest one call may take, in milliseconds.

username.description: The user of `user:password`, sent as HTTP Basic; empty when none.

endpoints.description: One to 16 nodes, in failover order.

RpcParameter.description: One query parameter of a node's URL.

header.description: Whether every call sends it as a header instead of in the URL.

name.description: The parameter's name, or for a `header.<Name>` one, the header's.

Send.description:
`POST /v1/wallets/{id}/transactions` body: an ordered send from the
path's wallet in one asset.

asset.description: An asset id of the wallet's network; default `native`.

ServerHour.description: One hour of this server's time.

failed.description: Jobs that failed for good in it.

addresses.description: Distinct addresses indexed, keyed or watch-only.

chain.description:
The last day of chain time (up to the newest kept block), hour by
hour, oldest first.

enabled.description: Of those, how many are enabled.

server.description: The last day of this server's time, hour by hour, oldest first.

transactions.description: Transactions kept mined in live blocks.

tags.description:
Every tag in use on any wallet, sorted, each once. A wallet's own
tags are on it (`GET /v1/wallets`).

Transaction.description:
A kept transaction: its `transaction` row and its kept legs. The API
shows it as is. Read in one query: its legs come as a JSON array SQLite
builds (`legs`).

expires_at.description: Unix ms it stops holding funds; null once mined.

order.description: Its position in its block; null while pending.

reason.description: Why it reverted (JSON), when the chain said; null otherwise.

sent_at.description: Unix ms it was recorded as pending; null once mined.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page; null on a short page. Always present.

transactions.description:
At most `limit` transactions in kept blocks, in chain order, each
with only the wallet's legs of the asset (atomic amounts; a mined
leg's `position` is its block's). Kept blocks reach the produced
tip, so the last ones may still be taken back by a reorg.

TransferItem.description: One ordered transfer of a send.

amount.description: Exact positive decimal in display units.

destination.description: Recipient address text, as the wallet's chain writes it.

Trigger.description: One `trigger` row; the API shows it as is.

action.description:
What it does: `{"name": "send", "input": {"source": target, "asset":
id, "destination": target, "amount": amount}}`.

check.description:
When it acts: `{"since": {"seconds": …}}` and compares under
`all`/`any`/`not`.

filter.description:
Which of them it acts on: compares under `all`/`any`/`not`; null:
every one.

group.description: The batch it was created in: every trigger of one create shares it.

selector.description:
Which wallet indexes it acts on: `{"ids": […]}`, `{"asset": "…"}`,
`{"tag": "…"}`, `{"untagged": {}}`, `{"all": […]}`, `{"any": […]}`, `{"not": …}`.

TriggerBatch.description: `POST /v1/triggers` body: triggers of one network stored together, all or none.

triggers.description: One to 16 triggers, each with its `id`.

TriggerDefinition.description: A trigger as written: in a `POST` (with `id`) or as a `PUT` body.

id.description: Its slug; required in a `POST`, refused in a `PUT` (the path names it).

index_state.description:
`paused`: skipped, no facts kept for blocks while paused; `indexing`:
resumed from `paused` or `no_data` (clearing its reason), backfilling
what it missed. `no_data` is the indexer's to set.

Wallet.description:
One wallet, as the API shows it: an address, whether its key is kept,
its tags, and its indexes (each with its balances, progress and legs;
read by [`db::find_at_tip`] and [`db::list_at_tip`], empty from the other
reads). The key (`curve`, `secret`) is never serialized, and the API
reads leave it out. No `Debug`: it may hold the key.

indexes.description: Its indexes by asset id (`native` or the token id).

keyed.description: Whether this server holds its key and can send from it.

tags.description: Its tags, sorted, each once, each [`is_tag`].

WalletIndex.description:
One asset of one wallet being indexed, as every read answers it (the
API shows it as is): its columns, how far it is indexed against its
network's tip, its balances and its pending legs. All computed in SQL
(`db::BY_IDS`); amounts are exact atomic decimal text, never summed.
Positions are native (height or slot).

balance_confirmed.description: The same at or below `finality_at`; null when that is unknown.

behind_tip.description:
Blocks between `indexed_through` and the network's produced tip;
null before the first block or without a tip.

birthday.description:
The start indexed from: the one asked for, or the first block the
node served when it no longer served that one.

finality_at.description:
The network's final (confirmed) block the read was given; null when
unknown.

indexed_through.description: The last block indexed; null before the first.

legs.description:
Its pending legs (no block, no total), by id; its mined ones are
paged by `leg::db::find_page`.

next_cursor.description:
Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page. Always
present.
